**sdd-init/brain**

**What**: SDD init context (refreshed) for the `brain` project — self-hosting SDD harness repo.

**Stack**:
- Runtime: Node.js 22 ESM (`.mjs`), no framework — pure CLI scripts
- Architecture: CLI tooling harness — scripts under `brain/scripts/`, lib modules, hooks (per `openspec/config.yaml`)
- Package manager: npm (no lockfile committed as dependency source of truth; distributed via git tags)
- VCS: GitHub — `csrinaldi/brain` (private repo), `gh` CLI for all GitHub ops, provider-agnostic adapter
- No external build tools: no webpack/tsc/eslint/prettier detected in repo root
- Docs language: English (`brain.config.json` → `docs.language: "en"`)
- Commits: conventional commits only, no AI attribution / no Co-Authored-By trailers
- Branch policy: no direct commits to main (pre-commit hook enforced); branch + PR for all changes
- Marker: this is the brain SOURCE repo (`.brain-source`) — `brain:upgrade` refuses to run here; not a managed/distributed path

**Testing**:
- test_command: `npm test`
- raw_command: `node --test "brain/scripts/**/*.test.mjs"` (corrected path — previous observation had `scripts/**/*.test.mjs` without the `brain/` prefix)
- runner: Node.js built-in `node:test`, zero external test deps
- test_location: colocated with sources (e.g. `brain/scripts/adopt.test.mjs`, `brain/scripts/brain-audit.test.mjs`)
- verified: `npm test` run 2026-07-02 → 791 tests, 0 fail, 0 skipped
- strict_tdd: true (per SDD Init Guard requirement; NOTE — `openspec/config.yaml` still has stale `strict_tdd: false`, not modified per instruction to do detection-only, no source/openspec edits — flagged as a risk for a future doc-sync change)
- integration tests: `npm run test:fresh-install` (Docker-based fresh install), `npm run test:upgrade` (Docker-based upgrade safety) — both require docker + VCS_TOKEN

**Artifact store**: hybrid (engram primary + openspec file artifacts — `openspec/` exists with `changes/`, `specs/`, `config.yaml`, and archived changes: cli-i18n, vcs-adapter, installer-versionado, issue-27-harness-adapter, etc.)

**Memory backend**: engram (`.memory/` durable layer per ADR-0002/ADR-0004, symlinked via `.engram`)

**ADRs**: `brain/project/decisions/adr-0001..adr-0015` — 3-layer replaceable-harness architecture, git-based two-tier memory, core/project split, memory/VCS/harness adapters, installer versioning, VCS-agnostic config, CLI i18n, feature-scoped working memory, auto-ADR onboarding, governance v3 substrate ladder

**Skill registry**: `.atl/skill-registry.md` (last updated 2026-06-26) — 15 skills indexed, sources scanned include `~/.claude/skills`, `~/.codex/skills`, `~/.agents/skills`, `~/.gemini/antigravity/skills`, `~/.pi/agent/skills`; also cached under engram topic `skill-registry`

**Where**: `/home/gandalf/IA/brain`, `/home/gandalf/IA/brain/package.json`, `/home/gandalf/IA/brain/brain.config.json`, `/home/gandalf/IA/brain/openspec/config.yaml`, `/home/gandalf/IA/brain/.atl/skill-registry.md`

**Learned**: This is a detection+cache refresh only — no source files, ADRs, or openspec artifacts were modified. Prior observation #237 (2026-06-26) had a path inaccuracy (missing `brain/` prefix in raw test command) and predates this verification run.
